items.title: 19.4 Aliphatic organic compounds ke naam (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the nomenclature of aliphatic compounds (PDF 41-44).

blocks.text: Qudrat mein karoron organic compounds hain aur har saal hazaron naye banaye jate hain, is liye IUPAC (International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry) ne un ki banawat se baqaida naam rakhne ke usool banaye. Systematic naam parent hydrocarbon par mabni hota hai aur is ke yeh hisse hain:

items: Stem ya root: sab se lambi musalsal carbon zanjeer jis mein functional group wala carbon shamil ho; us carbon ko sab se kam mumkin number milta hai. Halqe ke liye cyclo lagta hai.
Primary suffix (stem ka suffix): batata hai ke zanjeer saturated hai ya unsaturated: -an-, -en- ya -yn-.
Secondary suffix (functional group ka suffix): khandani naam deta hai, maslan -ol, -al, -one.
Prefix: kisi shaakh (alkyl group) ya substituent, jaise halo ya nitro, ka naam aur jagah, us carbon ke number ke saath jis se jura ho. Prefix na ho to naam sirf stem aur suffixes hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar shaklon ki zanjeer: peela daira 'Prefix', neela hexagon 'Stem/Root name', neela hexagon 'Primary Suffix (Suffix of Stem/root)' aur peela daira 'Secondary Suffix (Suffix of F.G.)'. Teer Prefix se 'substituent and its position on the parent chain', Stem se 'No. of carbon atoms in the parent chain', Primary Suffix se 'saturation or unsaturation in the parent chain (an, en, yn)' aur Secondary Suffix se 'family name' ki taraf jate hain.
blocks.caption: Systematic (IUPAC) naam ke hisse (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Naam ko baen se daen parhein. Prefix batata hai ke shaakh ya substituent kaun sa hai aur zanjeer ke kis carbon par hai (maslan 3-methyl, 4-chloro). Stem zanjeer ke carbon ginta hai: meth 1, eth 2, prop 3, but 4, pent 5. Primary suffix batata hai ke zanjeer saturated (an) hai ya us mein double (en) ya triple (yn) bond hai. Secondary suffix khandan (family) batata hai, maslan -ol alcohol, -al aldehyde. Prefix na ho to naam sirf stem aur suffixes se banta hai, maslan butanal.

blocks.alt: Do hal shuda misalein. Pehli: Cl-CH2-CH2-CH2-C(=O)-H, zanjeer ke carbon baen se 4, 3, 2, 1 numbered, aur naam dabbe mein 4-chloro | but | an | al hisson mein, jin par prefix, stem, suffix of stem aur suffix of F.G likha hai. Doosri: CH3-C(CH3)=CH-CH2-OH, numbered 4, 3, 2, 1, naam 3- methyl | but- | 2-en- | 1-ol, unhi chaar naamon ke saath.
blocks.caption: Misalein: 4-chlorobutanal aur 3-methylbut-2-en-1-ol, prefix, stem aur suffixes mein (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka; kitab ki ghalati durust).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab pehli misal ki zanjeer ko 1 se 4 tak number karti hai lekin naam '4-chloro prop an al' chhaapti hai. Zanjeer mein chaar carbon hain, is liye stem 'but' hai aur sahih naam 4-chlorobutanal hai; khaake mein 'but' likha hai. Numbering hamesha us sire se shuru hoti hai jo functional group ke qareeb ho: aldehyde ka C=O wala carbon 1 hai, aur alcohol mein OH wala carbon 1.

items: Naam = prefix + stem + primary suffix + secondary suffix.
Sab se lambi zanjeer functional group ke qareeb sire se number karein.
